title: Import Wizard Update Permission Consistency

items.action: select worksheet, configure header, save mapping, and set import row decisions

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.imports.update permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing import wizard update authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

audit.reason: Existing import mutation auditing remains unchanged.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The wizard remains readable; only update mutations require imports.update.

notes: Import wizard update mutations were reachable without matching UI permission checks. Backend SelectImportSheet, ConfigureImportHeader, SetColumnMapping, SetImportRowDecision, and BulkRowDecision use cases require fair_crm.imports.update; the UI now fails closed and disables update entry points when that permission is absent.
